0.name: R
0.text: Yes, yes, very clever you are.

1.name: R
1.text: Such an intelligent creature, stuck in search of false comfort...

3.name: R
3.text: Now, now. Don’t mind me, let’s get to the bulk of this conversation.

4.name: R
4.text: There is an argument to be made about the pleasure of watching someone else suffer.

5.name: R
5.text: A facet of sadism, you could say.

6.name: R
6.text: But not simple pain, a blow to the head or a knife to the gut.

7.name: R
7.text: Broken hearts, mental stress, shattered dreams. That is the real entertainment.

8.name: R
8.text: You might say that this, in and of itself, isn’t the most interesting thing there is...

10.name: R
10.text: An old colleague of mine once struck it big with an investment opportunity.

11.name: R
11.text: The happiness on his face was contagious, I’ll concede. Enough money to give and donate and gift and spend on whatever he wanted.

12.name: R
12.text: But the news quickly went to his husband, of course.

13.name: R
13.text: And to him, there wasn’t one more rich person in the city. There were two

14.name: R
14.text: The husband also started spending the money, and suddenly the love of his life didn’t seem that interesting anymore.

15.name: R
15.text: To start with, something small. Clothes and shoes, a new car and the videogame he always wanted...

16.name: R
16.text: Which then devolved to alcohol, drugs, hookers and gigolos...

17.name: R
17.text: My colleague had to watch a sex party which he wasn’t invited to with his husband in tow and three years of happy memories going down the drain.

18.name: R
18.text: And you know what I felt when my dear friend told me that pitiful sob story?

20.name: R
20.text: Oh, you wouldn’t believe the feeling. The genuine happiness radiating from my face, the flutters in my heart.

21.name: R
21.text: My imagination went wild at every detail of that story, and the tears in his eyes twinkled in tears stamped with the face of his lover...

22.name: R
22.text: God, I could get hard just thinking about it.

23.name: R
23.text: I wish more people would openly express their sadness, just so I could hear it all and take in the feelings.

26.name: R
26.text: What about you, girl? Is your suffering also so delicious?

29.name: R
29.text: I’m just trying to open your eyes for more possibilities.

30.name: R
30.text: I hope you share your traumas the next time we meet.

31.name: R
31.text: And I’ll teach you how to appreciate it.
